thread:
Incident Bot: [PAGER] Multiple services firing: alert-cascade.service-errors -> high 5xx rate from storefront and embeddings workers. Paging oncall. https://grafana.company/redwood/d/r1/alerts
Sam: I see the spike, looks like cache TTL drop earlier caused bursts to backend. Checking redis metrics.
Priya: oncall-nyc here, paging in 30s if no ack. Can someone mute downstream noise? It's drowning the real pager.
Jordan: ack, taking lead. @Sam can you confirm cache evictions? I'll start a temporary rule to stop noisy child alerts.
Sam: redis evictions spiked at 12:13 UTC, key churn 8x baseline. Rolling restart of cache pool node-12 now.
Oncall-SRE: applied silence: alert:storefront-5xx and alert:embeddings-5xx for 10m pending mitigation. Will escalate if errors persist. :white_check_mark:
Product Ops: Customers seeing elevated latency/calls failing ~1-3% of requests. Tracking top customers in the dashboard.
Lina: Started scaling fallback workers to reduce pressure on primary DB: kubectl scale deploy/worker --replicas=6
Sam: node-12 back up, eviction rate down to 1.2x baseline. 5xxs decreasing.
Jordan: lifting broad silence? Let's keep some noise off while we validate. Oncall-SRE leave storefront-5xx muted, allow core-db alerts.
Oncall-SRE: updated silence to only noisy-service groups, set maintenance window 15m (start 1829876560 end 1829877460).
Priya: running query to validate new thresholds on recent p95/p99. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/d/alerts/alert-playbook
Product Ops: compiled affected customers list, reached out to top 5, no major loss of data, just retries. They're ok with postmortem.
Jordan: action items: 1) Update runbook with cache eviction signs + quick restart. 2) Revisit alert thresholds for storefront and embeddings (current triggers too tight). 3) Add circuit-breaker metric to dashboard.
Sam: suggested provisional threshold changes:
```
alert:storefront-5xx if rate > 5% for 2m -> change to >7% for 2m
alert:embeddings-5xx if rate > 4% for 1m -> change to >6% for 1m
```
Lina: will validate by replaying a short traffic sample against thresholds in staging dashboard. Recommend a gradual rollout of threshold change.
Priya: confirm post-incident cleanup: remove temporary silences, set maintenance window end, and run an alert drill tomorrow.
Oncall-SRE: temporary silences cleared at 1829877120. Maintenance window closed. Leaving documented changes in #eng-sre.
Jordan: thanks team. Filing follow-ups: ENG-1234 (runbook update), ENG-1235 (threshold tuning), ENG-1236 (dashboard panel for circuit-breaker). Owners: Sam/ Priya/ Lina.
Product Ops: noted customer outreach log updated. Will coordinate any required client follow-up.
Sam: quick note — we should add a small hysteresis to cache TTL changes to avoid ripple. I'll put a short RFC.
Incident Bot: Incident resolved, duration ~12m. Paging resumed to normal. :tada:
Product Ops: +1 on RFC. Great work, concise mitigation. Closing thread and moving post-incident review to #postmortems.
